Environmental stress chamber AR Series
Product catalog summary
Overview: The document details the ESPEC AR series Environmental Stress Chambers, designed for rigorous environmental testing, particularly for automotive and mobile products. These chambers accurately simulate environmental conditions to meet stringent testing requirements.
Specifications: The AR series offers two temperature control ranges: −75℃ to ＋180℃ and −45℃ to ＋180℃, with chamber capacities of 680 L and 1100 L. They support heat loads up to 4500 W and feature advanced temperature and humidity control systems, including a Balanced Temperature and Humidity Control system (BTHC).
Performance: The chambers achieve heating and cooling rates of up to 6.3℃/min and 4.8℃/min, respectively, ensuring uniform temperature distribution and reduced stabilization times for enhanced testing efficiency.
Features: Key features include a user-friendly design with cable ports, water supply systems, and durable stainless steel construction. Programmable instrumentation allows flexible operation and data monitoring via a large color LCD display.
Compliance and Safety: The chambers comply with international environmental test standards (IEC60068, ISO16750-4) and safety standards (ISO12100, ISO14121, CE marking). They include safety devices to protect against overcurrent, short circuits, and other hazards.
Recommendations: Users should avoid using explosive, inflammable, or corrosive materials within the chambers to prevent hazards and equipment damage. Reading the user manual thoroughly before operation is crucial.
Main Features: The chambers offer history display, backup operation, power failure recovery, automatic and manual drainage, constant humidity measurement, timer functions, and a help feature for user assistance.
Accessories: Included accessories are cable port rubber plugs, shelf bracket, stainless steel shelf, cartridge fuses, wet-bulb wick, thermocouple, specimen temperature input connector, and a user’s manual.
Options: Available options include temperature and humidity recorders, temperature sensor terminal, DC output terminals, viewing window, relay contact output, humidifier delay control, paperless recorder, portable tank, power cable, condenser filter, water purifier, communication function, overheat and overcool protectors, trouble buzzer, warning signal light, external alarm terminal, and emergency stop switch.
Additional Information: Load resistance shelves are available for specimens exceeding the maximum allowable load. The document provides contact information for ESPEC offices in Japan, North America, Europe, China, and Malaysia, and notes ISO 9001:2000 certification for quality management.
